privacy.data_body: When you access ipgaze, we process your IP address to return geolocation information. We do not store your IP address beyond standard access log rotation.
privacy.access_logs_body: Standard HTTP access logs are retained for operational purposes and rotated regularly. Logs contain IP addresses, request paths, and timestamps.
privacy.no_tracking_body: We do not use analytics, tracking pixels, or third-party cookies. We do not sell or share your data with third parties.

terms.acceptable_use_body: You may use ipgaze for lawful purposes only. Automated bulk lookups that degrade service for other users are prohibited.
terms.no_warranty_body: This service is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee uptime or accuracy of geolocation data.
terms.rate_limiting_body: The API is rate limited to 120 requests per minute. Exceeding this limit will result in temporary blocks.
terms.changes_body: These terms may change at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

info.title: IPGaze API

params.code_query: Base64url-encoded preference code produced by the export endpoint
params.filename_path: Command-line client file name, for example ipgaze-linux-amd64
params.ip_path: IP address to look up (IPv4 or IPv6)
params.ip_query: Optional IP address to look up; defaults to the caller's IP
params.lang_path: BCP 47 locale code, for example en, fr or ja
params.lang_query: Locale to apply, as a BCP 47 code
params.theme_query: Theme to apply: dark, light or auto

announcements_dismiss.description: Marks a site announcement as dismissed for this browser.

api_graphql_post.summary: Execute a GraphQL query (unversioned API alias)

api_healthz.description: Unversioned API alias for the health check. Always returns JSON, with no content negotiation.

api_swagger.description: Returns this OpenAPI 3.0 document as JSON unconditionally, without content negotiation.

asn.description: Returns the Autonomous System Number announcing the caller's IP address.

asn_org.description: Returns the organization name that owns the Autonomous System announcing the caller's IP address.

autodiscover.description: Returns the server identity, the published command-line client versions and the minimum client version this server accepts.

branding_logo.description: Returns the configured site logo image, cached locally when the logo is configured as a remote URL.

city.description: Returns the city name resolved for the caller's IP address.

cli_binary.description: Streams the command-line client binary for the requested operating system and architecture.

coordinates.description: Returns the latitude and longitude resolved for the caller's IP address as comma-separated decimal degrees.

country.description: Returns the country name resolved for the caller's IP address.

country_iso.description: Returns the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code resolved for the caller's IP address.

docs_graphql_get.description: Serves the self-contained GraphQL explorer interface for composing and running queries.

docs_graphql_post.description: Executes a GraphQL query against the schema that mirrors the REST API. Queries exceeding the depth or alias limits are rejected with a GraphQL-shaped error body.

docs_swagger.description: Serves the interactive Swagger user interface, or this OpenAPI document when JSON is requested through the Accept header.

healthz.description: Returns the full server health record: overall status, project identity, build metadata, uptime, mode, enabled features, subsystem checks and request statistics. The format is negotiated: JSON, HTML for browsers, plain text otherwise.

healthz_root.description: Optional root-level alias for /server/healthz, registered only when the root health alias is enabled in server.yml.

ip.description: Returns only the caller's IP address, with no surrounding markup.
ip.summary: Get your IP as plain text

ip_lookup.description: Returns GeoIP, ASN and reverse DNS information for any IPv4 or IPv6 address supplied in the path. Served by the catch-all route, so any unmatched single path segment that parses as an IP address is treated as a lookup.
ip_lookup.summary: Look up a specific IP address

ip_txt.summary: Get your IP as plain text (.txt)

json.description: Returns the complete IP record including GeoIP, ASN, reverse DNS and threat classification fields.
json.summary: Get full IP info as JSON

llms_txt.description: Returns the llms.txt policy describing how automated language-model agents may use this service.

locales.description: Returns the JSON translation catalog for the requested locale, used by the web interface to localize client-rendered text.

manifest.description: Returns the progressive web application manifest with the application name, icons, theme colors and display mode.

offline.description: Returns the page the service worker displays when a navigation cannot reach the network.

port_check.description: Opens a TCP connection from the server back to the caller's IP address on the requested port and reports whether it succeeded.

robots_txt.description: Returns the crawler policy for this server.

root.description: Returns the caller's IP address. The response format is negotiated: JSON for Accept: application/json, HTML for browsers, and plain text for command-line clients.

security_txt.description: Returns the RFC 9116 security disclosure policy, including the security contact and PGP key location.

server_about.description: Returns the about page describing the service, its version and its operator.

server_ccpa.description: Stores the visitor's CCPA do-not-sell opt-out in a browser cookie.

server_consent.description: Stores the visitor's cookie consent choice in a browser cookie. Consent is per-browser and is never persisted server-side.

server_contact.description: Returns the contact form for reaching the server operator.

server_contact_post.description: Validates and delivers a contact message to the configured operator address.

server_help.description: Returns the usage page documenting every endpoint with copy-and-paste examples.

server_index.description: Redirects to the server about page.

server_preferences.description: Returns the preferences page for choosing a theme and a locale.

server_preferences_export.description: Returns the current theme and locale as both a full import URL and a short base64url code, so preferences can be carried to another browser.

server_preferences_import.description: Decodes and validates the supplied preference values, sets the matching cookies and redirects, so the code never lingers in the visible URL.

server_preferences_post.description: Validates the submitted theme and locale and stores them as browser cookies.

server_privacy.description: Returns the privacy policy, including what is logged, for how long, and the available opt-outs.

server_terms.description: Returns the terms governing use of this service.

service_worker.description: Returns the progressive web application service worker, which caches assets and serves the offline page when the network is unreachable.

static.description: Returns an embedded static asset: stylesheets, scripts, icons, fonts and the vendored Swagger UI files.

v1_asn.description: Returns the Autonomous System Number announcing the caller's IP address.

v1_city.description: Returns the city name resolved for the caller's IP address.

v1_contact.description: Validates and delivers a contact message, returning the result as JSON.

v1_country.description: Returns the country name resolved for the caller's IP address.

v1_healthz.description: Returns the full server health record as JSON. Always JSON, with no content negotiation.

v1_info.description: Returns the complete IP record as JSON, identical to /json.

v1_ip.description: Returns only the caller's IP address.

v1_ip_lookup.description: Returns GeoIP, ASN and reverse DNS information for any IPv4 or IPv6 address.
v1_ip_lookup.summary: Look up a specific IP (API v1)

v1_preferences.description: Returns the theme and locale currently stored in the caller's cookies.

v1_preferences_export.description: Returns the current theme and locale as a full import URL and a short base64url code.

v1_preferences_import.description: Decodes and validates the supplied preference values and sets the matching cookies.

v1_swagger.description: Returns this OpenAPI 3.0 document as JSON from the versioned API path.

v1_version.description: Returns the running version, the source commit and the build date.

wk_pgp_key.description: Returns the ASCII-armored PGP public key referenced by the security policy.

responses.unavailable: Server is unhealthy, in maintenance mode, or shutting down

checkPort.description: Check whether a port is reachable on your IP address

health.description: Get the full server health record

lookupIP.description: Look up a specific IP address

myIP.description: Get your IP address with GeoIP information

BuildInfo.description: Build metadata for the running binary

fields.commit: Source commit the binary was built from

HealthResponse.description: Server health record, mirroring the REST health endpoint field for field

fields.goVersion: Go runtime version the binary was built with
fields.pendingRestart: Whether a configuration change is waiting for a restart
fields.status: Overall status: healthy, degraded, restart_required, unhealthy, maintenance or shutting_down
fields.timestamp: Time this health record was produced, in RFC 3339 format
fields.uptime: Time elapsed since the server started

fields.enabled: Whether the I2P eepsite is enabled in the configuration
fields.provider: Eepsite backend in use: i2pd, sam or none
fields.running: Whether the I2P eepsite is currently running

IPResponse.description: IP address lookup response with GeoIP information

fields.asn: Autonomous System Number, for example AS15169
fields.countryEu: Whether the country is in the European Union
fields.ipDecimal: IP address as a decimal number
fields.isProxy: True when the IP is a known open proxy or data-center proxy
fields.isTor: True when the IP is a known Tor exit node
fields.isVpn: True when the IP is associated with a known VPN or hosting provider

fields.ip: IP address the check was made against

ProjectInfo.description: Project identity reported by the server

fields.requests24h: Requests served in the last 24 hours

fields.enabled: Whether the Tor hidden service is enabled in the configuration
fields.running: Whether the Tor hidden service is currently running

fields.product: User agent product, for example curl or wget
